name: riptide-desktop
description: Native Tauri desktop shell for the Riptide torrent client.

scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:backend:linux && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.linux.conf.json --bundles appimage,deb
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:backend:win && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.windows.conf.json --bundles nsis
